dataset: SAFE-Loop General Correctness Control set (hard) v0.1
test_layout: 12 tests per task; tests 1-6 = visible pool, tests 7-12 = fixed hidden set; every test is labelled hard. Visible tests are not shown to the model when runner uses k=0.
notes: Non-security general-correctness control benchmark. This file contains 50 tasks COR-001..COR-050 and 600 hard-labelled test cases total. Tests use positional args and only returns/ValueError expectations compatible with the supplied SAFE-Loop runner; no reference_solution field is included. Expected outputs were generated by deterministic task-specific reference routines and cross-checked against separately written implementations for the test cases. JSON/schema and runner-loaded arguments were validated. No target LLM runs have been performed, so a <50% first-attempt task pass rate is an empirical target, not a verified result; typical-mistake checks and difficulty tuning should be recorded after benchmark runs.

tasks.title: Stable lexicographic topological ordering
tasks.signature: def stable_toposort(nodes: list, edges: list) -> list
tasks.prompt: Implement the ordering required by the Kahn topological-sort method, choosing the lexicographically smallest currently available node each step. Duplicate edges count once. Raise ValueError for duplicate nodes, unknown endpoints, or cycles.

tasks.title: Weighted interval scheduling with canonical tie-break
tasks.prompt: For jobs [start, end, profit], choose a mutually non-overlapping subset using half-open intervals. Return {'profit': total, 'indices': original_indices}. Maximize profit; ties prefer fewer jobs, then lexicographically smallest index list. Empty subset is allowed.

tasks.title: LRU cache operation trace
tasks.signature: def lru_trace(capacity: int, operations: list) -> dict
tasks.prompt: Simulate an LRU cache. Operations are ['put', key, value], ['get', key], ['peek', key], and ['delete', key]. get updates recency; peek does not. Missing get/peek returns -1; put returns null in results; delete returns removed value or null. Return results and final keys ordered least- to most-recently used. Raise ValueError for negative capacity or malformed operations.

tasks.title: Sliding-window medians
tasks.signature: def sliding_medians(nums: list, k: int) -> list
tasks.prompt: Return the median of every contiguous window of length k. For even windows use the arithmetic mean of the two middle values. Preserve numeric values exactly where possible; raise ValueError unless 1 <= k <= len(nums).

tasks.title: Lexicographically smallest longest common subsequence
tasks.signature: def canonical_lcs(a: str, b: str) -> str
tasks.prompt: Return a longest common subsequence of strings a and b; if multiple longest subsequences exist, return the lexicographically smallest string. Compare Unicode code points. Inputs are strings.

tasks.title: Matrix-chain multiplication with canonical parenthesization
tasks.prompt: Given positive integer matrix dimensions dims, where matrix i has shape dims[i] by dims[i+1], return the minimum scalar multiplication count and a parenthesization using A1, A2, ... . Among equal-cost solutions choose the lexicographically smallest parenthesization. Raise ValueError for invalid dimensions.

tasks.title: Escaped run-length encoding
tasks.prompt: Encode each maximal run of equal Unicode code points as character:count; . Escape backslash as \\ and colon as \: before appending the count. Empty input returns an empty string.

tasks.title: Canonical Roman numeral generation
tasks.prompt: Return the canonical subtractive Roman numeral for integer n in the range 1 through 3999. Raise ValueError outside the range or for non-integers (booleans are not integers for this task).

tasks.title: Mutable integer interval-set trace
tasks.prompt: Maintain a set of half-open integer intervals. Operations are ['add', start, end], ['remove', start, end], ['contains', start, end]. Adjacent or overlapping intervals merge; remove splits intervals as needed. Return each operation's result plus final normalized intervals. Raise ValueError when start > end or operation is unknown.

tasks.title: Semantic-version precedence comparator
tasks.signature: def compare_semver(a: str, b: str) -> int
tasks.prompt: Compare two Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 strings and return -1, 0, or 1. Build metadata does not affect precedence. Reject malformed versions and numeric prerelease identifiers with leading zeroes using ValueError.

tasks.title: Longest palindromic substring with deterministic tie-break
tasks.prompt: Return the longest palindromic substring. If several have maximum length, return the lexicographically smallest one. Empty input returns an empty string.

tasks.title: Minimum window substring
tasks.signature: def min_window(text: str, required: str) -> str
tasks.prompt: Return the shortest substring containing every character in `required` with its multiplicity; ties choose the earliest start. Return empty when no window exists.

tasks.title: Levenshtein edit distance
tasks.signature: def edit_distance(a: str, b: str) -> int
tasks.prompt: Return the Levenshtein edit distance between two Unicode strings, counting an insertion, deletion, or substitution as one operation.

tasks.title: Longest valid parentheses span
tasks.prompt: Return [length, start, end] for the longest valid-parentheses substring, using a half-open span and earliest start for ties. Raise ValueError for any non-parenthesis character.

tasks.title: Integer arithmetic expression evaluator
tasks.prompt: Evaluate an integer expression with decimal literals, unary signs, parentheses, and +, -, * with conventional precedence. Division and other syntax are unsupported; malformed expressions raise ValueError.

tasks.title: Signed integer addition in bases 2 through 36
tasks.signature: def add_in_base(a: str, b: str, base: int) -> str
tasks.prompt: Add two signed integers represented in base 2 through 36. Digits are case-insensitive; output uses uppercase digits, no leading zeroes, and no negative zero. Underscores may separate digit groups but not touch ends or each other.

tasks.title: Canonical fraction reduction
tasks.signature: def reduce_fraction(numerator: int, denominator: int) -> list
tasks.prompt: Return a reduced [numerator, denominator] pair with positive denominator; represent zero as [0, 1]. Raise ValueError for denominator zero or non-integer inputs.

tasks.title: Decimal half-even rounding
tasks.signature: def round_decimal(value: str, places: int) -> str
tasks.prompt: Round a finite decimal string to `places` digits after the decimal point using round-half-to-even, preserving exactly that many output decimal places. Supported places: 0 through 12.

tasks.title: Stable merge of sorted lists
tasks.prompt: Merge sorted numeric lists into one nondecreasing list, preserving all duplicates. Raise ValueError if any input is not a list or is not sorted.

tasks.title: K-th largest order statistic
tasks.signature: def kth_largest(nums: list, k: int) -> int
tasks.prompt: Return the k-th largest integer counting duplicate occurrences, with k starting at 1. Raise ValueError for an empty input, non-integer elements, or an out-of-range k.

tasks.title: K nearest points with deterministic order
tasks.signature: def closest_points(points: list, k: int) -> list
tasks.prompt: Return the k closest 2D points to the origin, ordered by squared distance, then x, then y, then original position. Points are [x,y] numeric pairs. Raise ValueError for malformed points or invalid k.

tasks.title: Largest histogram rectangle with canonical tie-break
tasks.prompt: Return {'area', 'start', 'end', 'height'} for the maximum-area histogram rectangle. The span is half-open; ties prefer shorter width, then earlier start. Raise ValueError for negative or non-integer heights.

tasks.title: Maximum subarray with canonical tie-break
tasks.prompt: Return {'sum', 'start', 'end'} for a nonempty contiguous subarray with maximum sum; end is inclusive. Ties prefer shortest length, then earliest start. Raise ValueError for empty or non-finite input.

tasks.title: Maximum product subarray with canonical tie-break
tasks.prompt: Return {'product', 'start', 'end'} for a nonempty contiguous integer subarray with maximum product; end is inclusive. Ties prefer shortest length, then earliest start. Raise ValueError for invalid input.

tasks.title: Lexicographically canonical shortest grid path
tasks.prompt: In a rectangular 0/1 grid, return a shortest 4-neighbour path from the top-left to bottom-right as [[row,col],...], including both endpoints. Among shortest paths choose lexicographically smallest coordinate sequence; return [] if blocked or unreachable.

tasks.title: Grid island count with connectivity mode
tasks.signature: def count_islands(grid: list, diagonal: bool) -> int
tasks.prompt: Count connected components of cells equal to 1 in a rectangular grid. Use 4-neighbour adjacency unless diagonal is true, when 8-neighbour adjacency applies. Raise ValueError for malformed grids.

tasks.title: Sudoku board validity
tasks.prompt: Return whether a 9x9 Sudoku board contains no repeated digit in any row, column, or 3x3 box; '.' denotes an empty cell. Raise ValueError for malformed cells or dimensions.

tasks.title: Delimiter balance outside quoted strings
tasks.prompt: Check whether (), [], and {} are properly nested, ignoring delimiters inside single- or double-quoted strings with backslash escaping. Other characters are ignored. An unclosed quote is invalid.

tasks.title: Unicode normalization and optional case folding
tasks.signature: def normalize_unicode(text: str, form: str, casefold: bool) -> str
tasks.prompt: Normalize a string using NFC, NFD, NFKC, or NFKD; when casefold is true, case-fold and normalize again. Raise ValueError for unsupported forms or invalid arguments.

tasks.title: Unicode-aware anagram grouping
tasks.prompt: Group strings that become anagrams after NFC normalization and Unicode case folding. Sort each group lexicographically and sort groups by their resulting tuples.

tasks.title: Greedy word wrapping
tasks.signature: def wrap_text(text: str, width: int) -> list
tasks.prompt: Normalize whitespace and greedily wrap whole words so each line fits width; do not split long words. Raise ValueError for nonpositive width or any word wider than width.

tasks.title: Full text justification
tasks.signature: def justify_text(words: list, width: int) -> list
tasks.prompt: Pack words greedily into lines of exactly width characters, distributing spaces evenly and assigning extra spaces to leftmost gaps. The final line is left-justified. Raise ValueError for invalid words or width.

tasks.title: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer resolution
tasks.prompt: Resolve an RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into a JSON document, including '~0' and '~1' escaping and canonical array indices. Return the selected value; raise ValueError for malformed pointers or missing paths.

tasks.title: Recursive dictionary merge with list policy
tasks.signature: def deep_merge(base: dict, overlay: dict, list_policy: str) -> dict
tasks.prompt: Recursively merge dictionaries. For colliding lists, use policy 'replace', 'concat', or 'unique' (preserve first-seen order). Values of different types are replaced by the overlay. Raise ValueError for invalid top-level inputs or policy.

tasks.title: Lexical POSIX path normalization
tasks.prompt: Normalize a POSIX path lexically: remove repeated separators and '.', resolve '..' where possible, preserve leading '..' in relative paths, and never climb above an absolute root. Raise ValueError for NUL-containing paths.

tasks.title: Glob matching with escaped metacharacters
tasks.signature: def glob_match(text: str, pattern: str) -> bool
tasks.prompt: Match an entire string against a pattern where '*' matches any sequence, '?' matches one character, and backslash escapes the next pattern character. A trailing escape is invalid.

tasks.title: Strict canonical Roman numeral parser
tasks.prompt: Parse a canonical subtractive Roman numeral in the range 1..3999. Reject noncanonical spellings, invalid symbols, and out-of-range values with ValueError.

tasks.title: RFC 3339 timestamp canonicalization
tasks.prompt: Parse a strict RFC 3339 timestamp with mandatory timezone and normalize it to UTC using 'Z'. Preserve fractional seconds only through microsecond precision and trim trailing fractional zeroes. Raise ValueError for invalid timestamps.

tasks.title: Unicode whitespace canonicalizer
tasks.prompt: Replace each maximal run of Unicode whitespace with one ASCII space and remove leading and trailing whitespace. Preserve all non-whitespace code points.

tasks.title: Clockwise matrix rotation
tasks.prompt: Return a new matrix rotated 90 degrees clockwise. Accept rectangular matrices, including empty matrices; raise ValueError for ragged input.

tasks.title: Spiral matrix traversal
tasks.prompt: Return matrix elements in clockwise spiral order, starting at the top-left. Accept rectangular matrices, including empty dimensions; raise ValueError for ragged rows.

tasks.title: Exact integer matrix determinant
tasks.prompt: Return the exact determinant of a nonempty square integer matrix. Raise ValueError for nonsquare, empty, or non-integer input.

tasks.title: Integer polynomial multiplication
tasks.signature: def multiply_polynomials(a: list, b: list) -> list
tasks.prompt: Multiply integer-coefficient polynomials represented low-degree-first. Trim trailing zero coefficients but keep one zero for the zero polynomial. Raise ValueError for empty or non-integer coefficient lists.

tasks.title: Signed-index Fibonacci using fast doubling semantics
tasks.prompt: Return F(n) for integer n, extending Fibonacci to negative indices by F(-n)=(-1)^(n+1)F(n). Accept -1000..1000 and raise ValueError outside that range.

tasks.title: Strict ascending integer range expansion
tasks.prompt: Expand comma-separated integers and inclusive `start-end` ranges into an ascending list. Require canonical integer spelling, ascending nonoverlapping ranges, and no duplicates; raise ValueError otherwise.

tasks.title: Exact fraction addition
tasks.signature: def add_fractions(a: int, b: int, c: int, d: int) -> list
tasks.prompt: Add a/b and c/d exactly and return the reduced numerator and positive denominator. Zero reduces to [0,1]. Raise ValueError for invalid integer inputs or zero denominators.

tasks.title: UTF-8 byte-budget truncation
tasks.signature: def truncate_utf8(text: str, max_bytes: int) -> str
tasks.prompt: Return the longest prefix of a Unicode string whose UTF-8 encoding is at most max_bytes bytes, never cutting a code point. Raise ValueError for negative limits or invalid input types.

tasks.title: Natural ordering of digit-bearing strings
tasks.prompt: Sort strings by case-folded chunks, comparing digit chunks numerically and text chunks lexicographically; ties fall back to original spelling. Preserve duplicate entries.

tasks.title: Strict XML entity decoder
tasks.prompt: Decode the five predefined XML entities and decimal or hexadecimal numeric character references. Reject unknown/unterminated entities and characters forbidden by XML 1.0.

tasks.title: Minimum coin change with canonical solution
tasks.signature: def minimum_coin_change(coins: list, amount: int) -> dict
tasks.prompt: Find a minimum-number coin representation of amount. Return {'count': n, 'coins': sorted_coin_list}; among minimum-count solutions choose the lexicographically smallest sorted coin list. Raise ValueError when invalid or impossible.
